prompt: When a Shopify order is paid, deduplicate against prior webhook deliveries by order id + hmac, then enqueue an Airtable upsert that key-matches on Order Number.

plan.summary: When a Shopify order is paid, deduplicate by order id + hmac, then upsert a record in Airtable key-matching on Order Number.

target.docsQuery: Airtable Web API upsert record by field order number

additionalTargets.docsQuery: Shopify webhook hmac verification request body signature

fieldMapping.note: Shopify order ID mapped to Airtable Order Number field
string payload value, Airtable expects number or string depending on field type

assumptions: The webhook payload includes order.id, order.customer.email, order.total_price, and an HMAC signature for deduplication.
Airtable table already contains a field named 'Order Number' that uniquely identifies records.
The integration will compute an idempotency key from order.id + hmac and check for existing records before upserting.
Airtable's upsert operation will match on the 'Order Number' field and update if present, otherwise create a new record.

sources.title: Upserting multiple fields based on API data with an automation script | Airtable Community

notes: Verify HMAC using X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256 header and raw request body with app's client secret.
Deduplicate using X-Shopify-Webhook-Id header to skip duplicate deliveries.
Topic for paid orders is orders/updated (as payment capture triggers an update).
Respond with 2xx status quickly; process payload asynchronously.
Payload includes order.id (under ucp.id), order.customer.email (not shown in example but assumed present per plan), order.total_price (sum of totals where type is total), and HMAC from header.
Endpoint for manual HMAC verification; computes HMAC-SHA256 of raw body using client secret and compares to X-Shopify-Hmac-SHA256 header.
Use timing-safe comparison to avoid timing attacks.
Must parse raw body before verification; do not use body parsers that alter the raw payload.
Airtable Web API does not have native upsert; connector must first query for existing record by 'Order Number' field, then PATCH to update if found or POST to create if not.
Pagination not applicable as this is a single record upsert via filterByFormula.
To upsert: GET /v0/{baseId}/{tableName}?filterByFormula={Order%20Number}%3D'{orderId}' to check existence, then PATCH/{recordId} if exists or POST if not.
Field 'Order Number' must be present and unique in the target table.
Total Price may need conversion from string (e.g., '79.77') to number depending on Airtable field type.
